claim: Try it with sample data opens exactly three realistic invoices in an isolated demo workspace.
where: Landing action, demo banner, and README
sandbox: Fresh browser context; enter from the landing action, assert the three named sample invoices, isolate real and demo changes, and reset the demo.

claim: Due invoices show stage-specific drafts to review.
sandbox: Demo workspace; open a due invoice and inspect the editable draft.

claim: Reminder templates and private invoice context are editable.
sandbox: Demo workspace; edit a template and context note, reload, and inspect both.

claim: Reminder history, pause notes, and paid status persist.
sandbox: Demo workspace; mark one reminder sent, mark its invoice paid, pause another invoice with a note, reload, and assert every field.

claim: You can edit a draft, copy it, or open an email draft before sending.
sandbox: Demo workspace; edit a draft and assert exact copied output plus both review actions.

where: Landing, draft dialog, terms, and README
sandbox: Demo workspace; copy a draft and prove explicit sent confirmation remains required.

claim: You can export and import a JSON backup.
sandbox: Demo workspace; export, delete local data, import the downloaded backup, and inspect restored invoices.

claim: You can export the invoice list as CSV.
sandbox: Demo workspace; download CSV and assert its header plus one row for every sample invoice.

claim: You can delete all local workspace data.
sandbox: Demo workspace; create history, paid state, changed settings, and a private note; delete and assert the workspace store is empty and defaults are restored.

claim: Works offline after the first visit.
sandbox: Dedicated browser context; visit demo, wait for service worker control, go offline, and reload.

claim: The workspace and legal pages fit a 390px screen with 200% text size.
sandbox: Mobile browser context; demo, privacy, and terms routes at 200% text with no horizontal overflow.

claim: Free includes five active invoices and exactly three editable reminder steps.
where: Pricing copy, cadence, settings, and README
sandbox: Fresh workspace; edit one of exactly three steps, add five future invoices, and verify the sixth is blocked.

claim: Plus supports at least 25 active invoices and up to five reminder steps.
where: Pricing copy, cadence, settings, and README
sandbox: Fresh workspace with a recorded valid billing response; add 25 active invoices and reach the five-step boundary.

claim: Gentle Nudge Plus costs US $18 once with no subscription.
sandbox: Fresh landing page; inspect the visible price and registered hosted-checkout action.

claim: Normal workspace data stays on this device.
sandbox: Fresh workspace; add an invoice and inspect the complete request log for same-origin requests only.

claim: No analytics, trackers, third-party scripts, or remote fonts run.
sandbox: Fresh demo page; inspect every page request for same-origin delivery.

claim: The app does not connect to banks or invoice providers, profile clients, predict payment, use collection threats, or send automatically.
sandbox: Fresh Settings view; inspect the visible product limits list.

claim: License verification is the only app-initiated external request, and only after a license is supplied.
sandbox: Fresh page request log before and after a recorded license-verification response.
